features.text: LIGAMENT STABILIZATION: Concealed side hinges support mild MCL, LCL, ACL, and PCL instabilities.
SECURE WRAP CONTROL: Adjustable wraparound straps allow quick tightening and stable positioning.
BREATHABLE AIRMESH COMFORT: Ventilated fabric helps manage heat and moisture during activity.
LIGHTWEIGHT, LOW PROFILE DESIGN: Competition friendly construction fits under uniforms and gear.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PDAC APPROVED L1812, L1810: Eligible for insurance reimbursement (check with your provider).
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
